asset.title: Startup Diligence War Room
asset.purpose: README live walkthrough clip. Judge whether the feature is obvious, visually consistent, and credible as evidence.

judge.summary: Excellent walkthrough demonstrating multi-agent startup diligence with clear public/private lanes, live data enrichment, and structured outputs.

featureClarity.evidence: Demonstrates company enrichment, multi-agent prompt execution, and private agent interaction clearly.

workflowCompleteness.evidence: Shows the full flow from pending enrichment to completed data, multi-agent execution, and private drafting.

visualDesign.evidence: High-density, polished dark UI with clear active states and clean side panels.

consistency.evidence: Perfectly aligns with the NodeRoom paradigm of files, spreadsheets, and public/private agent lanes.

evidenceQuality.evidence: Authentic product interaction showing real-time updates, agent logs, and UI state changes.

legibility.evidence: UI text is dense and small at standard resolution, but readable; bottom captions assist comprehension.

professionalRelevance.evidence: Highly applicable to financial analysts, venture capital, and startup diligence workflows.

productionHonesty.evidence: Explicitly highlights that downstream integrations are draft-only and require human approval.

observedEvidence: Interactive spreadsheet with pending and completed enrichment states
Multi-agent prompt execution in public chat with real-time trace
Private agent lane toggle and private query execution
Draft export options (Gmail, Notion, Slack) with approval gates
judge.suggestedReadmeCaption: Run multi-agent startup diligence workflows with source-backed enrichment, collaborative spreadsheets, and secure private agent lanes.
